validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="x" expr="0"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <if cond="x === 1">
        <log expr="'one'"/>
      <else if cond="x === 2"/>
        <log expr="'two'"/>
      </if>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<else if …>` is not SCXML: a conditional branch is the single element `<elseif>`
notes: SCXML documents must be well-formed XML 1.0 with namespaces; no later validation runs until parsing succeeds
